main_text.p: lum, Hipericum, Heliochrysos, Lapa-thum, Majorana, Marrubium, Melis-sa, Nasturtium, Origanum, Ocymum, Pulegium, Polium, Petrofelinum, Oreo-felinum, Raphanus, Ruta, Rosmari-nus, Smyrnium, Salvia, Sabina, Seseli, Serpillum, Trifolium odoratum, Vitex, Urtica.
Menses sistunt : Bursa pastoris, Fragaria, Hyoscyamus, Limonium, Lysimachia, Myrtus, Nymphaæ[?], Plantago, Ru-bus, Sempervivum, Symphytum, Solanum,&c.

Venenis resistunt : Abrotanum, Ab-sinthium, Allium, Adianthum, Apium, Brassica, Betonica, Carduus benedictus, Chamaedrys, Cyclaminus, Calamintha, Eupatorium, Eryfimum, Fæniculum, Iuniperus, Lybisticum, Carlina, Marru-bium, Origanum, Pulegium, Polium, Ruta, Scordium, &c.
Strumas discutiunt : Adianthum, A-parine, Althea, Lupinus, Lapathum, Melissa, Galiopsis, Nasturtium, Penta-phyllum, Scordium, &c.
Dolorem mitigant : Anethum, Ab-sinthium, Asclepias, Atriplex, Chamae-

page.notes: Long s read as s throughout, so "Melis-sa", "Seseli", "Bursa" and "Absinthium" are plain s. "Nymphaæ" is doubtful in its ligature. The page number is read as 248 from a worn 8. The catchword "melum," completes the word "Chamae-melum" at the page foot.
